sources.source: F1 known closed observer directory; complete result row absent

observation.scope: Actual indexed compressed frames only, including interrupted F1. Native save/fork snapshots are operational diagnostics, not observer anchor frames. Fixed ROI reads and q1+8 small witnesses are different instruments. No planned frame is counted as captured.

resources.scope: Committed Job/process memory, working set and private bytes are reported separately. These are sampled host-resource observations; absent fields and unsampled peaks are not reconstructed. They do not measure Native cognitive memory or demonstrate a leak.
